SEARCH
Package dao

Class ReportsDAO

java.lang.Object
dao.ReportsDAO
public class ReportsDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) for all analytics and reporting queries in the MIRAGE system.

This class provides read-only queries that aggregate data across multiple tables to produce the six management reports displayed on the ReportScreen. All reports are scoped to the previous calendar month unless otherwise noted, computed dynamically using SQL Server's DATEADD and GETDATE() functions — no hardcoded dates.

All methods in this class are read-only (SELECT only). No data is mutated by any report query.

Reports provided

  1. getMostPopularSuiteClass() — Suite class with the most reservations overall
  2. getHotelsWithNoExperiencesLastMonth() — Hotels with zero experience bookings last month
  3. getTopConciergeLastMonth() — Concierge with highest total experience value last month
  4. getGuestsWithNoExperiencesLastMonth() — Guests who reserved but booked no experiences last month
  5. getAvailableSuitesPerHotelLastMonth() — Suites not reserved at any point last month
  6. getGuestSpendLastMonth() — Each checked-out guest's total suite spend last month

  • Method Details

    • getMostPopularSuiteClass

      public String getMostPopularSuiteClass() throws SQLException
      Returns the suite class with the highest total number of reservations across all time (not limited to last month).

      The result is formatted as a single human-readable string: "<class_name> — <count> reservations".

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT TOP 1 sc.class_name, COUNT(r.reservation_id) AS total
   FROM reservation r
   JOIN suite s ON r.suite_id = s.suite_id
   JOIN suite_class sc ON s.class_id = sc.class_id
   GROUP BY sc.class_name
   ORDER BY total DESC
      Returns:
      a formatted string with the most popular suite class and its reservation count; "No data." if the table is empty
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getHotelsWithNoExperiencesLastMonth

      public List<String> getHotelsWithNoExperiencesLastMonth() throws SQLException
      Returns the names of all hotels that had zero guest experience bookings during the previous calendar month.

      A hotel is considered to have had an experience if any reservation_experience row — joined back through reservation → suite → hotel — has a booked_date falling within the previous calendar month. Hotels not appearing in that set are included in this report.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT h.name FROM hotel h
   WHERE h.hotel_id NOT IN (
       SELECT s.hotel_id
       FROM reservation_experience re
       JOIN reservation r ON re.reservation_id = r.reservation_id
       JOIN suite s ON r.suite_id = s.suite_id
       WHERE MONTH(re.booked_date) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
         AND YEAR(re.booked_date)  = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
   )
      Returns:
      a List of hotel name strings with no experience activity last month; contains "All hotels had experiences last month." if the list would otherwise be empty
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getTopConciergeLastMonth

      public String getTopConciergeLastMonth() throws SQLException
      Returns the concierge who managed the highest total value of experience bookings during the previous calendar month.

      Total value is computed as the sum of actual_cost across all reservation_experience rows handled by each concierge in that month. Only the top-ranked concierge is returned.

      The result is formatted as: "<full_name> — $<total_value>".

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT TOP 1 c.full_name, SUM(re.actual_cost) AS total_value
   FROM reservation_experience re
   JOIN concierge c ON re.concierge_id = c.concierge_id
   WHERE MONTH(re.booked_date) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
     AND YEAR(re.booked_date)  = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
   GROUP BY c.full_name
   ORDER BY total_value DESC
      Returns:
      a formatted string naming the top concierge and their total value; "No data." if no experience bookings exist for last month
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getGuestsWithNoExperiencesLastMonth

      public List<String> getGuestsWithNoExperiencesLastMonth() throws SQLException
      Returns guests who made at least one reservation last month but did not book any add-on experiences during that same month.

      The query uses two subqueries:

      • An IN subquery to find guests with a check-in last month.
      • A NOT IN subquery to exclude guests who appear in reservation_experience with a booking date last month.

      Each result is formatted as: "<full_name> | <email>".

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT g.full_name, g.email FROM guest g
   WHERE g.guest_id IN (
       SELECT r.guest_id FROM reservation r
       WHERE MONTH(r.check_in) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
         AND YEAR(r.check_in)  = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
   )
   AND g.guest_id NOT IN (
       SELECT r.guest_id
       FROM reservation_experience re
       JOIN reservation r ON re.reservation_id = r.reservation_id
       WHERE MONTH(re.booked_date) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
         AND YEAR(re.booked_date)  = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
   )
      Returns:
      a List of formatted strings, one per guest; contains "No guests without experiences last month." if all guests booked at least one experience
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getAvailableSuitesPerHotelLastMonth

      public List<String> getAvailableSuitesPerHotelLastMonth() throws SQLException
      Returns all suites that were not reserved at any point during the previous calendar month, grouped by hotel.

      A suite is considered reserved for the month if any active reservation overlaps the month window — i.e. its check_in is on or before the last day of last month AND its check_out is on or after the first day of last month. Suites not meeting this criterion are returned.

      Results are ordered by hotel name, then suite number.

      Each result is formatted as: "<hotel_name> — Suite <suite_number>".

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT h.name AS hotel_name, s.suite_number
   FROM suite s
   JOIN hotel h ON s.hotel_id = h.hotel_id
   WHERE s.suite_id NOT IN (
       SELECT r.suite_id FROM reservation r
       WHERE r.check_in  <= EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
         AND r.check_out >= DATEFROMPARTS(
               YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH,-1,GETDATE())),
               MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH,-1,GETDATE())), 1)
   )
   ORDER BY h.name, s.suite_number
      Returns:
      a List of formatted strings, one per available suite; contains "No available suites last month." if all suites were reserved at some point during the month
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getGuestSpendLastMonth

      public List<String> getGuestSpendLastMonth() throws SQLException
      Returns each guest's profile alongside their total suite spending for the previous calendar month, limited to reservations with a status of 'checked-out'.

      Results are ordered by total spend descending (highest spender first), making it easy to identify top-value guests at a glance.

      Each result is formatted as: "<full_name> | <email> | <loyalty_tier> | $<spent>".

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT g.full_name, g.email, g.loyalty_tier, SUM(r.total_cost) AS spent
   FROM guest g
   JOIN reservation r ON g.guest_id = r.guest_id
   WHERE MONTH(r.check_in) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
     AND YEAR(r.check_in)  = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
     AND r.status = 'checked-out'
   GROUP BY g.full_name, g.email, g.loyalty_tier
   ORDER BY spent DESC
      Returns:
      a List of formatted strings, one per guest, ordered by spend descending; contains "No checkout data last month." if no checked-out reservations exist for the previous month
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query
